homepage.body:
Platform Solutions Ecosystem Resources FAQ
Sign in Book a demo
Platform Solutions Ecosystem Resources FAQ Sign in Book a demo
Supply-Side Platform · UMG Ecosystem

More demand for every impression you own.

uSSP connects your websites, apps and video inventory directly to premium, trusted demand partners across the UMG programmatic ecosystem — with ML-driven yield optimization turning unsold impressions into revenue instead of empty ad calls.

Contact us See how it works
15+years of AdTech expertise
100K+ad campaigns served yearly
10B+ad impressions available daily
Why publishers switch to uSSP

Built to move real inventory, not just ad calls.

Every part of uSSP is built around one goal — getting your impressions in front of demand that actually pays for them, without you losing visibility or control along the way.

High-quality demand

We work with premium demand partners and monitor fill quality closely, so your inventory is matched with buyers who actually convert — not junk traffic.

Full visibility

See exactly who's buying, at what price, and how each placement performs — real-time reporting down to the ad unit, with nothing hidden in a black box.

Placement control

Set price floors, choose formats, whitelist or block demand sources. You decide what runs on your inventory — uSSP just makes it profitable.

Direct demand access

Plug straight into large-scale Ad Exchanges, DSPs, SSPs and Ad Networks — the connections most publishers can't get on their own.

ML-driven yield

Machine-learning models pick the optimal floor price and demand mix for every impression in real time — no manual waterfall tuning required.

Cookieless-ready

Alternative ID support (ID5, UID2) keeps your inventory addressable — and monetizable — as third-party cookies disappear.

Built for your traffic

Whatever you run, there's a fit.

uSSP adapts to the shape of your inventory — from a single content site to a full-scale ad network reselling demand at volume.

FOR PUBLISHERS

Websites & content platforms

Monetize display, native and video placements across your site without juggling a dozen separate demand tags.

Talk to us
FOR APP DEVELOPERS

Mobile & in-app inventory

Rewarded, interstitial and banner formats connected to app-focused demand, with in-app-specific reporting and controls.

Talk to us
FOR SSPs & AD NETWORKS

Wholesale demand access

Plug your own network into uSSP's demand pool as a supply reseller and extend what you can offer your own publishers.

Talk to us
One ecosystem, full stack

uSSP is one piece of the UMG stack.

Pair your supply with UMG's demand-side, exchange and verification tools — or use uSSP entirely on its own.

uDSPDemand-side platform uAdExAd exchange White LabelYour own SaaS stack Ad VerificationBrand safety & anti-fraud Retail MediaNative ecommerce inventory

UMG has been building AdTech infrastructure since 2011 — uSSP runs on the same programmatic core that already powers 100,000+ campaigns a year across Eastern Europe, the Middle East and Asia.

Works alongside your existing stack — uSSP integrates with the anti-fraud, analytics and verification tools you already trust, including Protected Media, Weborama and AmberData, plus direct routes into partners like GPMD.

Resources

Get familiar before you go live.

Documentation

UMG Wiki

Integration guides, tag specs and platform reference for engineering teams.

Open docs →
Learning

Education hub

Programmatic fundamentals and platform training from the UMG team.

Start learning →
Tooling

VAST Inspector

Validate and debug your video ad tags before they go live on uSSP.

Inspect a tag →
FAQ

Common questions before connecting.

Is there a minimum traffic requirement to join uSSP?
We review every publisher individually rather than applying a hard traffic floor. What matters most is inventory quality: real audiences, brand-safe content, and compliant ad placements. Submit the form below and we'll assess your fit within a couple of business days.
How long does integration take?
For standard web integrations (JS tags or Prebid), most publishers go live within a few days of approval. In-app SDK and CTV/VAST integrations may take longer depending on your setup — your account manager will give you a concrete timeline upfront.
Which integration methods do you support?
Direct JS tags, VAST/VPAID, oRTB. If you have a non-standard setup, we'll work out a custom solution with your engineering team.
How do you protect against ad fraud and low-quality demand?
Every demand path is monitored with independent verification partners including MRC-accredited anti-fraud tools, combined with pre-bid filtering and manual review of new demand sources. You also keep full whitelist/blacklist control on your side.
How and when do publishers get paid?
Payouts follow a fixed monthly schedule against verified, reconciled statistics — no surprises at the end of the month. Payment terms and methods are agreed individually and fixed in your contract before launch.
Can I use uSSP together with my existing monetization stack?
Yes — uSSP is designed to run alongside your current SSPs, ad server and header-bidding setup, competing for impressions rather than replacing your stack. Many partners start with a share of inventory and scale up based on results.
Book a demo
Tell us a bit about your traffic and we'll come back with the fastest path to get you connected - no lock-in, no obligation.
Ready to put every impression to work?
